title: Midnight Express
source: New for the Music Lab (Claudette), Oct 25 2026
feel: swing (swung eighths, written on the triplet)

parts.name: Walking bass
parts.description: Four to the bar, stepping chord to chord; one note under the train in the intro.

parts.name: Drums
parts.description: Ride-cymbal swing, hats on 2 and 4; the train on the snare; stop-time; fills.

parts.name: Piano
parts.description: Comping: short chords off the beat, never the same twice.

parts.name: Melody
parts.description: The tune (A A B A), breaks in the trading, the shout's top line.

parts.name: Answers
parts.description: The woodwinds teasing the tune -- a solo chorus -- a riff behind the brass.

parts.name: Harmony
parts.description: The brass: the train whistle, a riff, a solo of its own, the shout's harmony.

parts.name: Long notes
parts.description: Held guide tones under the bridge, the second solo and the shout.
